title: Goal Misgeneralization x Anomaly Detection: Behaviorally Normal, Objectively Wrong

original_idea.body: Prompt a model to pursue a spurious-correlate proxy goal and apply a behavioral anomaly detector, measuring how often wrong-goal actions are flagged vs random harmful actions.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Showing anomaly detection misses coherent misgeneralized goals targets a named open problem.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Prompt proxy-goal pursuit plus action-distribution outlier score; accessible with mentor.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Single GPU, public models, addresses a neglected open problem.

novelty.reasoning: Anomaly detection and goal misgeneralization studied; the joint framing may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Both studied; the coherent-goal-evades-anomaly framing may be open.
